newsitem.title: GERMANY: German passenger traffic rises 2pct in March.
newsitem.headline: German passenger traffic rises 2pct in March.

text.p: The German air travel market picked up in March with a two percent growth rate over the same month last year, the German airport association ADV said.
The passenger market showed a rise of 1.8 percent in the first quarter of 1997 after virtual stagnation over the first two months of the year, the latest ADV traffic report show.
The German domestic market continued its decline of the last few months generated by lower business travel demand with a 5.3 percent fall in March.

But passenger traffic to and from European and intercontinental destinations from regional airports such as Berlin, Munich and Nuremberg rose more strongly than general market growth, the report showed.

This indicated the strategy of German carriers such as Eurowings Luftverkehrs AG and Deutsche BA in offering direct services from regional airports to European hubs was continuing to pay off, market observers said.
These passengers have been captured from Deutsche Lufthansa AG, which flies passengers through its Frankfurt hub.
